{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the average revenue per order for each channel, stratified by customer_segment
table = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Average revenue per order by channel and segment:")
print(table)

# Compute the total number of orders per channel
order_count = sales_df.groupby('channel').size()

# Compute the proportion of each customer_segment within each channel
segment_proportions = sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the weighted average revenue per order per channel
weighted_avg_revenue = segment_proportions.multiply(table).sum(axis=1)

# Display the weighted averages
weighted_avg_revenue"}
